liability.title: Disclaimer

Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.lead: How we handle your data when you visit the website or contact us.

controller.title: Who is responsible
controller.text: {company} is responsible for the processing of your data. For any question about data protection, write to us at {email}.

data.title: What data we process
data.text: When you use the form, we process your name, email address, phone number (if you give it) and your message. When you write to us or call us directly, we process the data of the message or the call. When you visit the website, the server records technical data such as the IP address, date and time, the page visited and the browser type.

purpose.title: Why we process it
purpose.text: We use the data from the form and from contacts only to answer your request and to prepare a quote. We use the technical data to run the website safely, for example to block automated messages (spam).

recipients.title: Who we share it with
recipients.text: The website is hosted by {hosting}. Form messages reach us by email through {mailProvider}. These providers process the data only on our behalf. We do not sell your data and do not use it for advertising.

abroad.title: Data abroad
abroad.text: If a provider processes data outside Switzerland, it does so only in countries with adequate protection or with contractual safeguards, as the law requires.

cookies.title: Cookies and statistics
cookies.text: The website uses no tracking cookies and no statistics or advertising tools. The fonts load from our own server, with no requests to Google.

links.title: Links to other services
links.text: The website contains links to WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook and Google Maps. Only when you open them do these services receive data from you; their own privacy policies apply.

retention.title: How long
retention.text: We keep messages as long as we need them for your request and for legal duties, for example the accounts of a job. The technical server data is deleted after a short time.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: Under the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP) you can ask what data we hold about you, have it corrected or deleted, and object to its processing. If the GDPR applies to you, you also have the right to data portability. Write to us at {email}. You can also contact the Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner (FDPIC).

changes.title: Changes
changes.text: We may update this policy when the website changes. The version published here applies.
